_comment: Evidence exemptions for docs/fidelity/field-coverage.csv. Each entry waives ONLY the evidence-pointer requirement for one row; an exemption always carries a written reason. Unsupported rows can never be exempted from their reason/review_by, a derived row needs no exemption, and a stale/unused entry fails the gate. In the style of testdata/coverage-exemptions.json. Empty since FC3: the generated negative-write suite (tests/gcpparity/fieldcoverage_test.go#TestGeneratedFieldRoundTrip) now drives the immutable/output-only write attempts that were previously uncovered.
